ctx.x: He was a character. He used to come into Eddie Condon’s all the time, and I used to see him all the time. I mean not all the time, whenever he was in New York. Because I was the house drummer at Eddie Condon’s for three years too, which was another Dixieland club. But then on Sundays I had the Metropolitan Bopera House, my own band. And I played bass, he played drums, and some other guys would play piano after hours. I even got to play with Roy Haynes playing drums, and I’m playing bass. I got to play with some…
was going to be coming in. Sarah Vaughan, anybody. Joe Jones would be at the end of the bar playing on a newspaper with brushes.
That guy loved to do that, didn’t he?
